title: Kids don't do what we tell them. They do what we do. 💔 #shorts
description:
Years later, he heard his sister say the exact words he used to say to her: "In a minute."

So he finally put his phone away… and gave back something she made when she was six.

▶ Watch the full film: https://youtu.be/OwTJ0oS_8lc
"He Was Always There… But Never Really There"

💬 What habit did you learn from your family without noticing?
